I have no money for chemical fertilizers or seeds from the shop, and at my age I follow the ways my mother taught me. I will use the seeds I saved from last season and put manure from our few animals on this small plot to help it grow. My grandchildren will help me with the planting and weeding since I cannot do all the bending and digging myself, but we cannot afford to pay anyone to work for us.
